q: By January 31, 2027, a company or government announcement, or a report by Reuters, Bloomberg, or Yonhap, confirms that the United States has issued, for each of Samsung's Xi'an plant and SK hynix's Wuxi and Dalian plants, an equipment import license valid for at least six months of 2027 (annual licenses, multiyear licenses, and restoration of VEU status all count)
basis: Equipment import licenses for 2026 were issued on December 30, 2025, one day before the plants' validated end-user (VEU) status expired, and TSMC's Nanjing plant (TSMC keeps only about 3 percent of its production capacity in China) received the same annual license. The U.S. administration does not want a memory supply shock. Whether the license conditions are tighter than those for 2026 will be noted separately. · AI and Chips issue
